requirements.title: Atomic operator-state boundary
requirements.description: Read and atomically commit operator choices exclusively in .vrooli/operator-state.json.

validation.notes: GET, PUT, and atomic persistence are covered.

requirements.title: No generated service configuration authority
requirements.description: Onboarding must not generate service.json or treat database progress as operator configuration authority.

validation.notes: Legacy preview endpoints remain while V2 readiness replaces them.

requirements.title: Shared operator control surface
requirements.description: UI and CLI use the same typed operator-state and read-model boundaries.

validation.notes: API contract is covered; CLI migration remains required.
